_comment: "When THIS is pitched, create a Runechant token." The gate was REF_PITCH_IS, which asks about the PITCH VALUE of a card a PREVIOUS effect stored under a ref -- and it reads `ref`, not `name`. Nothing had set the default ref, so the condition was false in every state and the token was never created. ON_PITCH already dispatches against this card's own definition, so "this is pitched" needs no condition at all.
